title: Powerwall Backup-Test Reserve Shortfall
app: Tesla Powerwall, Enphase IQ, SolarEdge, Sense, Emporia Vue, DSMR / P1 smart meters, and utility tariff exports collected via vendor APIs, Home Assistant, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=powerwall:aggregate event=backup_test
| stats min(battery_soc_pct) as min_battery_soc_pct by site_name test_id
| where min_battery_soc_pct<30
| sort min_battery_soc_pct
description: Uses Tesla Powerwall backup tests telemetry to monitor lowest battery reserve reached during backup exercises in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for tests that fell closer to empty than planned, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Tesla Powerwall backup tests data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Backup-test table of minimum battery reserve.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights lowest battery reserve reached during backup exercises so you can spot tests that fell closer to empty than planned before it becomes annoying.
